name: MTN Irancell Isfahan Data Center
notes: DC Byte lists an Isfahan Data Center in Iran operated by MTN Irancell as a self-build network and telco facility; Irancell social post referenced new data centers in Karaj, Mashhad, and Isfahan with 240 racks.

name: Irancell large National Information Network data center
notes: ICT Ministry provincial page says the large data center project was ready for operation/opening, built by Irancell with private investment for National Information Network cloud and infrastructure services.

name: Kurdistan provincial data center and ICT complex
developer: Iran Ministry of ICT / Kurdistan ICT office
notes: IRNA reported start of construction of a Kurdistan data center and ICT complex in Sanandaj on a 3,290 sqm site with 7,258 sqm building area, planned for completion after 18 months and then equipment by Iran IT Organization.

name: Hamadan provincial data center
developer: Iran Information Technology Organization / provincial ICT authorities
notes: Mehr reported Hamadan provincial data center was launched and supported by 11 servers, with rental and cloud-computing use available to users.

name: Hamadan Municipality primary, backup and database data centers
notes: Tender listing says Hamadan Municipality ICT Organization sought support, technical maintenance and operation for the municipality's main, backup, and database data centers.

name: Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari first provincial data center
notes: Fars reported the province's first data center was launched with 8 billion toman investment and was ready to provide high bandwidth and servers to agencies and private firms.

name: Shahrekord University Data Center
notes: University announcement says the data center opened during Government Week; it includes cooling, fire suppression, backup power, automatic data backup, more than 200 TB storage, SAN/NAS, firewall, and over 70 virtual machines.

name: MizbanPack Poldokhtar Data Center
notes: Provider page describes an operating data center in Poldokhtar, Lorestan, branded MizbanPack, with Tier III design claims, colocation/hosting use, redundant UPS/generator/chiller systems and biometric security.

name: Lorestan Telecommunication Shahid Rahimi data center
developer: Telecommunication Company of Iran - Lorestan region
notes: Local news quotes Lorestan telecom manager saying the province's first data center was in progress and foundation/substructure works had started at Shahid Rahimi center.

name: Ilam Province Justice Department Data Center
developer: Ilam Province Justice Department / Judiciary IT and Statistics Center
notes: Mehr reported the Ilam province justice department data center opened with the head of the Judiciary IT and Statistics Center present, for data centralization and improved service quality.

name: Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad provincial data center proposal
developer: Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Governorate / ICT Ministry stakeholders
notes: ISNA reported the provincial governor emphasized launching a data center in the province during an ICT-sector meeting with the communications minister; no construction or capacity was identified.

name: Bushehr Port Data Center
notes: Mehr reported the network infrastructure of the Bushehr Port data center was redesigned and updated to improve equipment organization, network structure, and service stability.

name: Bushehr University of Medical Sciences Smart Box POD container data center
developer: Bushehr University of Medical Sciences / Abgineh Pardaz Shargh
notes: Vendor project page says a five-rack Smart Box POD containerized data center for Bushehr University of Medical Sciences was successfully built and commissioned in Bushehr.

name: Zanjan ICT Center and provincial data center
developer: Iran Ministry of ICT / Zanjan ICT office
notes: IRNA reported start of construction for the Zanjan ICT center and provincial infrastructure data center; the basement was allocated to the provincial data center, with 150 billion rial construction and 200 billion rial equipment funding needs.
